verdict.rationale: Asana publishes an official OpenAPI specification for its REST API (./defs/asana_oas.yaml) and for app components in the first-party Asana/openapi GitHub repo, so an AI-native user can download a machine-readable spec. The probe's 404s at standard docs-domain paths only show the spec isn't served there; they don't contradict the GitHub publication. Missing for 10: a discoverable spec URL on the developer docs domain (well-known/openapi.json paths 404), and a hands-on or independent check that the YAML file downloads and parses.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository contains the [OpenAPI Specification](https://swagger.io/specification/) for Asana's APIs.
To build (i.e., update) the OpenAPI specifications for the REST API (./defs/asana_oas.yaml) and for app components
